name: yoke
description: Governed adversarial development for AI agents — v3.0 agent council protocol. Three runtime persona subagents (Sr Eng, Sr QA, Sr Staff) spawn in parallel each cycle behind a deterministic sync barrier (Phase A), exchange réplicas inside a bounded council loop with a contradiction-detection arbiter (Phase B), and either advance on consensus or escalate Trigger 4 on cap-exhausted divergence (Phase C). All inside a binding human contract (Acceptance Contract). Canonical-memory reads and writes dispatch through providers.yaml to a peer plugin (claude-bedrock is the reference implementation); pluggable canonical-memory providers ship via the documented working-memory contract. The Orchestrator subagent survives in canonize-only mode at full-run termination. Manifesto: yoke.md.
